allow: PowerShell(Write-Output "--- electron path.txt ---"; if \(Test-Path node_modules/electron/path.txt\) { Get-Content node_modules/electron/path.txt } else { Write-Output "path.txt MISSING" }; Write-Output "--- dist folder ---"; if \(Test-Path node_modules/electron/dist\) { Write-Output "dist EXISTS" } else { Write-Output "dist MISSING" }; Write-Output "--- electron installed version ---"; if \(Test-Path node_modules/electron/package.json\) { \(Get-Content node_modules/electron/package.json -Raw | ConvertFrom-Json\).version } else { Write-Output "electron package MISSING" })

PowerShell(Write-Output "Process env: [$env:ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE]"; Write-Output "User env: [$\([Environment]::GetEnvironmentVariable\('ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE','User'\)\)]"; Write-Output "Machine env: [$\([Environment]::GetEnvironmentVariable\('ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE','Machine'\)\)]")
PowerShell(npm run typecheck 2>&1 | Select-String -Pattern "error TS" | Select-Object -First 20; Write-Output "=== exit $LASTEXITCODE ===")
PowerShell(npm run typecheck 2>&1 | Select-String -Pattern "error TS" | Select-Object -First 30; Write-Output "=== exit $LASTEXITCODE ===")
